brief:
Medical Aid for Palestinians warned that ongoing attacks on health facilities and acute shortages of essential supplies are intensifying the humanitarian and health crisis in Gaza, the Shehab Wire reported.

The organization cited sustained killing and assaults targeting medical infrastructure as key drivers of the deteriorating conditions. Healthcare shortages and infrastructure damage have compounded access to treatment for civilians across the territory.

title: Attacks and supply shortages deepen Gaza's health crisis
